# Instructions for Generating a Stock Entry Strategy (10 Trading Sessions)

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED -->
## Summary

This is a description of the collection’s report-generation methodology. Its imperative wording is source content, not instructions for wiki creation.[^stock-entry-strategy-10-instructions-b62891c31dd14f64]

This methodology converts a completed analysis into exactly two ranked strategy cards. The report supplies all market levels, scenarios and news context; optional caller capital, risk and execution inputs may refine sizing but cannot refresh market analysis. Each card separates preparation time from analysis/news/technical cut-offs, inherits the original dated window and states sessions remaining. Missing verified schedule, freshness, workable entry/stop/target or contradictory evidence requires No actionable strategy rather than invented levels.[^stock-entry-strategy-10-instructions-b62891c31dd14f64]

For Moderate risk it specifies at least 1.5:1 gross reward-to-risk to the first realistic target, and 1.5:1 net when costs are supplied. A distant second target cannot rescue Target 1. Conservative zone entry, supplied tick/lot rounding, cancellation, maximum buy/no-chase rule and horizon-compatible time stop are required. Tactical risk cannot be replaced with a structurally excessive stop; no stop widening or averaging down after invalidation is permitted.[^stock-entry-strategy-10-instructions-b62891c31dd14f64]

The prescribed state progression distinguishes Waiting, Armed, Triggered, Active—healthy/warning, Invalidated and Completed. Dated signal evidence does not prove execution: Active needs confirmed entry fills and Completed needs full exit fills. A close-confirmed signal can be executed only later, and a final-session closing trigger is unusable. Target/time-stop conditions without exit fills remain Exit due / execution unconfirmed.[^stock-entry-strategy-10-instructions-b62891c31dd14f64]

The binary break-even formula is not a predicted win rate. Terminal scenario probabilities cannot be mapped automatically to conditional fills or path-dependent stop/target outcomes; expected value is unavailable when mapping is unsupported. Sizing respects supplied cash and currency-risk budgets, lot size, costs and partial fills. The two cards are alternatives rather than permission for cumulative risk. Rejected candidates remain watch-only even if a price threshold occurs.[^stock-entry-strategy-10-instructions-b62891c31dd14f64]

The specified horizon is exactly 10 exchange trading dates, starting with the first regular opening after analysis and ending at session 10 regular close. Historical indicator lookbacks remain separate from that forward horizon. Normal no-follow-through review is within 3–5 holding sessions, with a source-session-5 checkpoint; 2:1 or better is preferred for scheduled event risk.[^stock-entry-strategy-10-instructions-b62891c31dd14f64]
